note: The Windows source was NOT inventoried by this delivery. The inventory commands named below exist only on branch implement/aibox-migration-001 until it is reviewed and merged; the source must run them from a checkout of that reviewed commit. Everything below must be read on the source, read-only, and handed to the migration owner. No value in this list may contain a credential: DSNs, tokens, DPAPI blobs and .claude/.codex auth files are never exported. Counts and digests are computed while the source admission is still open (dry run), and again at the sealed barrier (final).

requirements.need: Operational PG container name, image reference, image RepoDigest (sha256), server major (SHOW server_version_num), database name, installed extensions with versions (SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension).
requirements.read_only_hint: docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}} {{.Image}}' <pg>; docker image inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' <image>; psql -tAc via docker exec

requirements.need: Every Zeus schema in that database (control + every lane from the registered Fleet config schema field), with its documents bucket list. Per schema: python -m codex_harness.adapters.host_migration pg-inventory --dsn-env <VAR> --schema <schema> (DSN stays in the named env var). Also: sequences, non-documents tables, and roles/grants the schemas depend on (pg_dumpall --globals-only is NOT exported; list role NAMES only).
requirements.read_only_hint: SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace; the Fleet registry config

requirements.need: Whether the source database holds only Zeus schemas or is shared with other projects; if shared, the explicit list of non-Zeus schemas that must NOT be moved.
requirements.read_only_hint: SELECT nspname, pg_size_pretty(sum(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid))) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace GROUP BY 1

requirements.need: Operational Redis container name (zeus-local-ops-redis observed), image reference and RepoDigest, INFO server redis_version, persistence config (CONFIG GET save/appendonly/dir), whether the instance is Zeus-only.
requirements.read_only_hint: docker exec <redis> redis-cli INFO server | findstr redis_version

requirements.need: Every configured redis_namespace (host + every lane) and python -m codex_harness.adapters.host_migration redis-inventory --url-env <VAR> --namespace <ns> ... output: key, type, value digest, PEXPIRETIME, stream length/last-generated-id/groups/PEL. Non-zero PEL entries must each be mapped to the PG effect/owner that explains them.
requirements.read_only_hint: Requires Redis >= 7.0 for PEXPIRETIME; the declared redis:7.4 satisfies it

requirements.need: The union of every artifact/evidence root actually referenced (D:/workspaces/zeus/artifacts including autonomous-operation-001/checklist-verification-artifacts, runtime observation spools, invocation ledgers, handoff receipts, rollback evidence outside the DB). Per root: python -m codex_harness.adapters.host_migration artifact-inventory --root <root> (entries, bytes, tree_sha256, anomalies: symlinks/junctions, case collisions).
requirements.read_only_hint: run from the source checkout's venv; the command only reads

requirements.need: Source repository HEAD commit, git status --porcelain=v1 -z digest and count, list of ignored-but-needed paths to preserve (git status --ignored), and every worktree (git worktree list --porcelain) with its dirty state.
requirements.read_only_hint: git -C <repo> rev-parse HEAD; git status --porcelain=v1 -z | sha256sum

requirements.need: Every process that can write Zeus state: scheduled tasks (schtasks /Query /FO CSV /V filtered to Zeus actions, including ZeusOwner-continuation and the user-cited BaldrixCronScheduler with its enabled state), running Claude/Codex worker containers (docker ps with zeus labels), web writers, CLI helpers, observers. For each: id, owner, Zeus-owned or not.

`zeus fleet status` projection (busy/held units, queued/dispatching/unknown jobs, leases, release leases, promotion intents), HostDelivery status, and the registered Fleet config digest (config_sha256).
Total bytes per PG schema dump (dry-run pg_dump -Fc size), Redis used_memory, artifact bytes; to size the copy over the observed 100 Mbps link.
requirements.read_only_hint: none of these require a pause

requirements.need: The runtime revision, worker image digest and worker profile digest the source services currently consume (HostDelivery descriptor/receipt).

Confirmation of WHICH auth adapters the source uses for Claude (setup-token -> OAuth env) and Codex, and their env var NAMES only. Values are re-issued on aibox for the service UID; nothing is copied.
